actionPrecisionStudy.scope: Train-only L40S probe found numeric inputs rounded and cached FP32 critic computations differing from BF16 inference. Keep the encoder/fusion precision and weights, run small action heads in FP32 in both fitting and inference.
actionPrecisionStudy.conditions: FP32 actions without numeric state; FP32 actions with numeric state; matched numeric no_value recovery. Compare all three to the frozen prior BF16 report as context.
actionPrecisionStudy.training: Same parent checkpoint, Train/Dev, two actual rollout collections, 40 maximum epochs each, learning rate, batches and normalized Dev selector. No language or demand training.
actionPrecisionStudy.initialEvaluation: Each fit records its initial policy on the same 95 exact-outcome Dev cases. Final evaluation covers all 336 retail and 60 original generated Dev cases.
actionPrecisionStudy.selection: Existing equal benchmark-normalized Dev mean. Promotion also requires generated raw loss <= 147.6812873 and retail <= 44.3274213, no false handoffs, no increase in unnecessary requests, no lower final parameter/evidence accuracy, unchanged constructor/GRU, and an actual improvement beyond numerical rounding. No Test selection or rerun.
